notes:
Background: mid-market product analytics SaaS with strong PLG motion. Primary goal is to replace noisy lexical search with semantic embeddings for product docs, release notes, and user FAQs. They run nightly batch embedding jobs for historical docs (2M docs initial) and realtime ingestion for new content (webhook -> queue -> embed). Preference for open-model embeddings with local hosting to avoid egress costs, but willing to start on Redwood Hosted to accelerate POC.

CTO quote: "Need <100ms median query for customer-facing FAQ search; if we can't hit that we'll lose conversion. Cost needs to be predictable for scale growth."

Key technical asks: integration with Postgres+pgvector (current prototype), ability to route large batch jobs (S3 -> embed) without throttling, connector to Milvus preferred for long-term, and an autoscaling Dedicated config that keeps tail latency under 250ms at 95p. Data residency: US-only for now. SOC2 required before procurement.

Commercial: evaluating Hosted API first to validate quality, then Dedicated for predictable unit economics. Interested in a 12-24 month reserved capacity price if throughput guarantees are provided. Wants per-route cost breakdown and token-level estimates in the console.

Sales notes: warm, engineering-first buyer. Decision will involve CTO + Head of Infra + Procurement. Budget discussion in progress.
use_case_summary: Primary workload: embeddings-powered semantic search for product docs and customer FAQs. Mix of nightly bulk re-embedding (2M doc corpus) and realtime low-latency retrieval for user queries. Also exploring semantic reranking for help-center search results.
technical_req_summary: Throughput target: sustain 400-600 QPS for semantic search queries during business hours with median query latency <100ms (ideal) and 95p <250ms. Batch embedding pipeline: ingest 100k - 500k new docs per night (S3 source), parallelized embedding jobs, connector options: pgvector (short-term), Milvus or Pinecone (long-term). Security: SSO/SAML, KMS for key management, audit logs, US-only data residency. POC asks: compare hosted embeddings latency + costs vs Dedicated 2-GPU/8-GPU configs; show autoscale behaviour and cold-start times; include estimated token/unit costs for 6 month projection.
